summary: Keep live argv mailbox capabilities through metadata-only declaration edits

replay.detail: No graph or projection replay, backfill or receipt rewrite. Existing local argv designation is checked in place against the current declaration.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, version or persistent row layout change. Existing owner, binding, lease and argv designation tables are retained.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, digest or replicated rule change.

compatibility.detail: Explicit argv channels retain their capability after tags, display name, environment and restart-policy changes that leave their launch unchanged. Host, runtime identity, workspace/cwd, terminal, exact raw argv, stop, native-provider and custody fences remain. No client protocol extension or mixed-version guarantee is introduced.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon deployment only; no new startup work. Source-specific restart-to-API or restart-to-health timing has not been measured.

manual.detail: No manual SQL, token replacement or seat restart is required by this change. Existing designation is revalidated through ordinary reads, reconnects and receipt commits.

recovery.detail: A downgrade restores the former metadata-edit refusal. Persistent mailbox custody from1894 remains; an older binary ignoring that custody is still not a qualified rollback. Same-provider native recovery and truthful-status production acceptance remain unverified.
